source: create a boat racing game, roblox McDonald are present in every boat with the text saying"inspired by McDonald. Boat are in line to start the race

answers.ask: No setting was stated - open sea, a river, a harbour, or a stylized water park?
answers.answer: Use a simple open-sea racing setting with a clear starting line and race course.

answers.ask: Is this one run from a start to a finish, or laps around a water circuit?
answers.answer: Make it one straight run from the starting line to a finish line.

answers.ask: How many boats line up at the start?
answers.answer: Line up 4 boats at the start.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D open-sea boat racing map with a straight race course from a clear starting line to a distant finish line. Four boats line up side by side at the start, each carrying a red-and-yellow fast-food-inspired mascot or sign with visible text reading "inspired by McDonald."
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Racing: the original request defines a boat race with a starting lineup and a course endpoint.

### Shape and preset
Use `route-point-to-point`, matching the Sprint / Drag preset. It is a single straight open-sea run from the start line to the distant finish, rather than a circuit; the prompt confirms this shape and retains the preset’s recognizable start-to-finish structure.

### Config requirements
Use `startpoint-line` as visible geometry and an invisible race-start marker: a clear transverse starting line across the water, with four aligned launch positions. Use `trigger-finish` as visible geometry and an invisible terminal detection zone: a prominent finish gate or line at the far end of the course. Use `lane-corridor` as visible geometry: subtle parallel buoy lines or floating markers define the straight water corridor without turning it into dry land. `water-body` is visible geometry: the open sea is the entire navigable race surface. The boats and their fast-food-inspired signs are visible props, not gameplay components.

### Layout components
The map is one long, rectangular open-water race corridor. At the near end, a broad starting zone spans the course width with a crisp starting line. Place exactly four boats side by side behind this line, evenly spaced and facing directly toward the finish. Each boat carries a red-and-yellow fast-food-inspired mascot or sign with clearly readable text: “inspired by McDonald.” The central course is open sea, bounded laterally by evenly spaced buoy lines that run straight toward the horizon. A large, high-contrast finish gate sits at the far end, centered on the course axis. Keep the water calm enough that the straight route, boats, and markers remain legible. There is no shoreline, harbour, landmass, or additional route branch; the open ocean forms the surrounding boundary. Compose the image from an elevated three-quarter view looking down the race direction, with the four-boat lineup prominent in the foreground and the finish visibly distant.

### Render order
Use `authored_plan`: this is a racing route whose straight, continuous, unbroken topology must remain playable from starting line through finish.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is large, driven by the long visible straightaway between the lineup and distant finish. Theme: clean Roblox-style open-sea speed race, bright blue water, clear buoy markers, red-and-yellow fast-food-inspired boat signage. Pipeline modifier: `P6`, forced by the race route’s required valid continuous start-to-finish course; `CHECK`, forced by the navigable water volume.
